<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem Diagram</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <style>
    @keyframes pulseA {
      0%, 100% { fill: rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.3); stroke: #2980b9; }
      30%, 50% { fill: rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.8); stroke: #1b4f72; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseB {
      0%, 30%, 100% { fill: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.3); stroke: #27ae60; }
      50%, 70% { fill: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.8); stroke: #145a32; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseC {
      0%, 70%, 100% { fill: rgba(155, 89, 182, 0.3); stroke: #8e44ad; }
      85%, 95% { fill: rgba(155, 89, 182, 0.8); stroke: #512e5f; }
    }
    @keyframes fadeInEq {
      0%, 70% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      85%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    
    .anim-a { animation: pulseA 6s infinite; }
    .anim-b { animation: pulseB 6s infinite; }
    .anim-c { animation: pulseC 6s infinite; }
    .eq-box { animation: fadeInEq 6s infinite; transform-origin: 625px 355px; }
  </style>

  <!-- Header Text (strictly within 20..780 X range) -->
  <text x="400" y="38" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50" text-anchor="middle">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>
  <text x="400" y="62" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#7f8c8d" text-anchor="middle">For any right-angled triangle, the sum of squares on the shorter sides equals the square on the hypotenuse.</text>

  <!-- Squares on sides (Triangle at A(240,230), B(330,350), C(240,350) - Unit = 30px) -->
  <!-- Square on side b (vertical, 4 units = 120px) -> Left of triangle -->
  <rect x="120" y="230" width="120" height="120" class="anim-b" stroke-width="2" rx="2"/>
  
  <!-- Square on side a (horizontal, 3 units = 90px) -> Below triangle -->
  <rect x="240" y="350" width="90" height="90" class="anim-a" stroke-width="2" rx="2"/>

  <!-- Square on hypotenuse c (5 units = 150px) -> Outward polygon -->
  <polygon points="240,230 330,350 450,260 360,140" class="anim-c" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- The Triangle itself (drawn on top for clean overlap) -->
  <polygon points="240,230 330,350 240,350" fill="#f8f9fa" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Right angle marker at (240, 350) -->
  <polyline points="240,338 252,338 252,350" fill="none" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Labels inside/near squares -->
  <!-- Square b area = 16 -->
  <text x="180" y="288" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#145a32" text-anchor="middle">b² = 16</text>
  <text x="180" y="308" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#27ae60" text-anchor="middle">4 units</text>

  <!-- Square a area = 9 -->
  <text x="285" y="393" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1b4f72" text-anchor="middle">a² = 9</text>
  <text x="285" y="413" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#2980b9" text-anchor="middle">3 units</text>

  <!-- Square c area = 25 -->
  <text x="405" y="200" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#512e5f" text-anchor="middle">c² = 25</text>
  <text x="405" y="220" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#8e44ad" text-anchor="middle">5 units</text>

  <!-- Triangle side labels (well spaced to avoid overlap) -->
  <text x="220" y="295" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50" text-anchor="middle">b = 4</text>
  <text x="285" y="342" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50" text-anchor="middle">a = 3</text>
  <text x="305" y="272" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#8e44ad" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(53, 305, 272)">hypotenuse (c = 5)</text>

  <!-- Information Panel on the Right -->
  <g transform="translate(490, 85)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="270" height="375" rx="10" fill="#f8f9fa" stroke="#bdc3c7" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <text x="135" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50" text-anchor="middle">Key Facts</text>
    
    <circle cx="25" cy="70" r="6" fill="#2980b9"/>
    <text x="45" y="75" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#333">Side a = 3 units</text>
    <text x="45" y="95" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#666">Area a² = 3 × 3 = 9</text>

    <circle cx="25" cy="140" r="6" fill="#27ae60"/>
    <text x="45" y="145" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#333">Side b = 4 units</text>
    <text x="45" y="165" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#666">Area b² = 4 × 4 = 16</text>

    <circle cx="25" cy="210" r="6" fill="#8e44ad"/>
    <text x="45" y="215" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#333">Hypotenuse c = 5 units</text>
    <text x="45" y="235" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#666">Area c² = 5 × 5 = 25</text>

    <!-- Animated Equation Box -->
    <g class="eq-box">
      <rect x="15" y="265" width="240" height="85" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="135" y="293" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">a² + b² = c²</text>
      <text x="135" y="325" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50" text-anchor="middle">9 + 16 = 25</text>
    </g>
  </g>

</svg>

  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <style>
    @keyframes pulse-dot {
      0%, 100% { r: 5px; opacity: 1; }
      50% { r: 8px; opacity: 0.6; }

      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }

      transform-origin: 350px 250px;

    }
    
    @keyframes trace-circ {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 942; }

      stroke-dasharray: 942;

  <!-- Sweeping Radius Group (Green) -->

  <!-- Radius Label (Green) -->

  <!-- Circumference Label (Orange) -->
  <text x="350" y="65" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#ea580c" text-anchor="middle">circumference</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Series Circuit GCSE Physics Diagram</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .wire { fill: none; stroke: #2c3e50; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .label { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; }
    .sublabel { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #7f8c8d; }
    .box { fill: #f8f9fa; stroke: #bdc3c7; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8px; }
    .highlight { fill: #e74c3c; }
    .charge { fill: #e67e22; r: 5px; }
    
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }
      100% { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(1.1); }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="500"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="35" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50">Series Circuit: Current & Voltage</text>

  <!-- Explanation Panel -->
  <rect x="440" y="60" width="340" height="415" class="box"/>
  <text x="460" y="90" class="label" fill="#2980b9">Key Physics Rules (GCSE):</text>
  
  <text x="460" y="130" class="sublabel" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50">• Single Loop:</text>
  <text x="480" y="155" class="sublabel">There is only one path for the</text>
  <text x="480" y="175" class="sublabel">charge to flow.</text>

  <text x="460" y="215" class="sublabel" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50">• Current:</text>
  <text x="480" y="240" class="sublabel"><tspan fill="#e67e22" font-weight="bold">Current</tspan> is the same everywhere.</text>
  <text x="480" y="260" class="sublabel">Ammeter 1 = 0.2 A, Ammeter 2 = 0.2 A</text>

  <text x="460" y="300" class="sublabel" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50">• Voltage:</text>
  <text x="480" y="325" class="sublabel">The <tspan fill="#8e44ad" font-weight="bold">voltage</tspan> of the cell is shared</text>
  <text x="480" y="345" class="sublabel">between identical components.</text>
  <text x="480" y="375" class="sublabel" fill="#8e44ad">6V = 3V + 3V</text>

  <!-- CIRCUIT DIAGRAM AREA (Left side: x: 40 to 420, y: 70 to 460) -->
  
  <!-- Outer Wire loop (Rectangle from x:80,y:100 to x:380,y:430) -->
  <rect x="80" y="100" width="300" height="330" class="wire"/>

  <!-- CELL (Top branch, centre x:230, y:100) -->
  <g transform="translate(230, 100)">
    <!-- Gap in wire for cell -->
    <line x1="-30" y1="0" x2="-15" y2="0" class="wire"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" class="wire"/>
    <!-- Cell symbol: Long thin bar (+), short thick bar (-) -->
    <line x1="-15" y1="-14" x2="-15" y2="14" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="-8" x2="-5" y2="8" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="5" y1="-14" x2="5" y2="14" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="-8" x2="15" y2="8" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Cell Label -->
    <text x="0" y="-22" text-anchor="middle" class="label">cell (6V)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- LAMP 1 (Left branch, centre x:80, y:230) -->
  <g transform="translate(80, 230)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-30" x2="0" y2="-18" class="wire"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="18" x2="0" y2="30" class="wire"/>
    <!-- Lamp Circle with Cross -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-12" y1="-12" x2="12" y2="12" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-12" y1="12" x2="12" y2="-12" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Lamp Label & Voltage -->
    <text x="-25" y="5" text-anchor="end" class="label">Lamp 1</text>
    <text x="-25" y="23" text-anchor="end" fill="#8e44ad" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">3V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- AMMETER 1 (Bottom branch, centre x:230, y:430) -->
  <g transform="translate(230, 430)">
    <line x1="-30" y1="0" x2="-18" y2="0" class="wire"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" class="wire"/>
    <!-- Ammeter Circle with A -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#2c3e50">A₁</text>
    <!-- Ammeter Reading Label -->
    <text x="0" y="30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e67e22" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">0.2 A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- LAMP 2 (Right branch, centre x:380, y:230) -->
  <g transform="translate(380, 230)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-30" x2="0" y2="-18" class="wire"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="18" x2="0" y2="30" class="wire"/>
    <!-- Lamp Circle with Cross -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-12" y1="-12" x2="12" y2="12" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-12" y1="12" x2="12" y2="-12" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Lamp Label & Voltage -->
    <text x="28" y="5" text-anchor="start" class="label">Lamp 2</text>
    <text x="28" y="23" text-anchor="start" fill="#8e44ad" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">3V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- AMMETER 2 (Top-left corner wire supplement for 2nd reading comparison) -->
  <g transform="translate(155, 100)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="#fff" stroke="#2c3e50" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="0" y="5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2c3e50">A₂</text>
    <text x="0" y="-22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e67e22" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold">0.2 A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ANIMATED CHARGES (Flowing clockwise around the perimeter: 300 width, 330 height rect from 80,100) -->
  <!-- Perimeter total distance = 2 * (300 + 330) = 1260 px -->
  <g>
    <!-- We generate multiple charge dots using animateMotion along the rectangular path -->
    <!-- Path matches the loop precisely: M 80 100 h 300 v 330 h -300 z -->
    <path id="circuitPath" d="M 80 100 h 300 v 330 h -300 z" fill="none" stroke="none"/>

    <!-- Charge Dot 1 -->
    <circle class="charge" r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite">
        <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>

    <!-- Charge Dot 2 -->
    <circle class="charge" r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite">
        <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>

    <!-- Charge Dot 3 -->
    <circle class="charge" r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-3s" repeatCount="indefinite">
        <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>

    <!-- Charge Dot 4 -->
    <circle class="charge" r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite">
        <mpath href="#circuitPath"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Interactive legend / instruction at bottom left -->
  <text x="230" y="475" text-anchor="middle" class="sublabel" font-style="italic">
    Dots show <tspan fill="#e67e22" font-weight="bold">current</tspan> flowing uniformly around the loop
  </text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <style>
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { r: 35px; opacity: 0.8; }
      50% { r: 45px; opacity: 1; }
      100% { r: 35px; opacity: 0.8; }
    }
    @keyframes rayPulse {
      0% { opacity: 0.3; stroke-width: 2; }
      50% { opacity: 0.8; stroke-width: 4; }
      100% { opacity: 0.3; stroke-width: 2; }
    }
    @keyframes flowInCO2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      50% { opacity: 1; }

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter</title>
  
  <style>
    /* Styling & Keyframe Animations */
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .box { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 3; rx: 12; }
    .title { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .caption { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .particle-solid { fill: #3b82f6; stroke: #1d4ed8; stroke-width: 2; }
    .particle-liquid { fill: #10b981; stroke: #047857; stroke-width: 2; }
    .particle-gas { fill: #f59e0b; stroke: #b45309; stroke-width: 2; }

    /* Solid: small vibration */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-1px, 2px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-2px, -1px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .vib-1 { animation: vibrate 0.4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .vib-2 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .vib-3 { animation: vibrate 0.45s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Liquid: sliding around */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(8px, 6px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-6px, 10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-10px, 4px); }
      66% { transform: translate(6px, -8px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(5px, -10px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-8px, -5px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .flow-a { animation: flow1 4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .flow-b { animation: flow2 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .flow-c { animation: flow3 4.5s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas: fast straight-ish paths */
    @keyframes bounce1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(50px, -45px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-30px, -70px); }
      75% { transform: translate(20px, 30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-60px, 35px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-20px, -40px); }
      75% { transform: translate(45px, 25px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(35px, 65px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-55px, 20px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-15px, -50px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce4 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-40px, -50px); }
      50% { transform: translate(60px, -20px); }
      75% { transform: translate(30px, 50px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .gas-1 { animation: bounce1 2.2s infinite linear; }
    .gas-2 { animation: bounce2 1.8s infinite linear; }
    .gas-3 { animation: bounce3 2.5s infinite linear; }
    .gas-4 { animation: bounce4 2.0s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="500"/>

  <!-- MAIN HEADER -->
  <text x="400" y="35" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">States of Matter</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID BOX ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="220" height="340"/>
    <text class="title" x="110" y="30">Solid</text>
    
    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular grid, vibrating) -->
    <g transform="translate(50, 70)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="0" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="0" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="0" r="12"/>
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="0" cy="30" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="30" cy="30" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="60" cy="30" r="12"/>
      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="0" cy="60" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="30" cy="60" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="60" cy="60" r="12"/>
      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-1" cx="0" cy="90" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-2" cx="30" cy="90" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-solid vib-3" cx="60" cy="90" r="12"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="240">Close together</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="265">Regular grid pattern</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="290">Vibrate in fixed positions</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="315" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Fixed shape & volume</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID BOX ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(290, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="220" height="340"/>
    <text class="title" x="110" y="30">Liquid</text>
    
    <!-- Liquid Particles (Close, irregular, sliding) -->
    <g transform="translate(45, 65)">
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-a" cx="15" cy="15" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-b" cx="45" cy="10" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-c" cx="80" cy="20" r="12"/>
      
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-b" cx="25" cy="45" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-c" cx="55" cy="42" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-a" cx="85" cy="50" r="12"/>
      
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-c" cx="10" cy="75" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-a" cx="40" cy="70" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-b" cx="75" cy="80" r="12"/>

      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-a" cx="25" cy="105" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-liquid flow-b" cx="60" cy="100" r="12"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="240">Close together</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="265">Random, irregular arrangement</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="290">Move past each other</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="315" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Takes shape of container</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS BOX ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(540, 60)">
    <rect class="box" x="0" y="0" width="220" height="340"/>
    <text class="title" x="110" y="30">Gas</text>
    
    <!-- Gas Particles (Far apart, fast, bouncing) -->
    <g transform="translate(110, 120)">
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-1" cx="-60" cy="-40" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="50" cy="-50" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-3" cx="-40" cy="40" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-4" cx="50" cy="40" r="12"/>
      <circle class="particle-gas gas-2" cx="0" cy="0" r="12"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Captions -->
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="240">Far apart</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="265">Random arrangement</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="290">Move fast in all directions</text>
    <text class="caption" x="110" y="315" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Fills whole container</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer instruction -->
  <text x="400" y="445" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Particles in solids vibrate, liquids flow, and gases move rapidly in all directions.</text>
</svg>
